clauses.title: Term & automatic renewal
clauses.text: This Agreement renews automatically for successive three (3) year terms unless Merchant provides written notice of non-renewal no fewer than 90 and no more than 120 days before the end of the then-current term.

clauses.title: Early termination - liquidated damages
clauses.text: If Merchant terminates before the end of the term, Merchant shall pay liquidated damages equal to fifty percent (50%) of Merchant's average monthly processing fees multiplied by the number of months remaining in the term, in addition to the Early Termination Fee.

clauses.title: Early termination fee
clauses.text: An Early Termination Fee of $495.00 per location applies to any termination before the end of the term.

clauses.title: Equipment lease
clauses.text: Terminal equipment is leased from Keystone Lease Co. under a separate 48-month non-cancellable lease at $69.95 per month. The lease survives termination of this Agreement and all remaining payments become immediately due.

clauses.title: PCI program
clauses.text: A PCI non-compliance fee of $39.95 per month will be assessed until Merchant validates compliance through the Processor's portal.

clauses.title: Fee changes
clauses.text: Processor may amend fees upon thirty (30) days' notice, which may be provided by message on Merchant's monthly statement. Continued processing constitutes acceptance.
